up: Find all distinct compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1148617'. Return the compound's ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical trial phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Filter using docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1148617', then join to compound_records on doc_id, to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and to compound_structures on molregno. Order the results by ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1148617' ORDER BY compound_chembl_id
